scr_cash_find_match_page.purpose: Matching aid in the new reconciliation tool that, for a selected imported bank transaction, searches G/L cash transactions for candidates by amount, date and reference so the preparer can pick the right match.
scr_cash_find_match_page.outcome: Hard-to-find matches (a bank debit that corresponds to a check keyed with a slightly different date) are located and cleared quickly.
scr_cash_find_match_page.rootCause: When auto-matching fails, the preparer needs a targeted search rather than scrolling the whole ledger. Find Match narrows candidates to plausible ones.
scr_cash_find_match_page.ifSkipped: Preparers give up on hard matches and carry them as reconciling items.
redFlags: Matches selected with different payees

scr_cash_excluding_bank_transactions_2.purpose: In the new tool, excludes bank transactions that should not be reconciled — duplicate feed lines or informational entries — from the matching list.
scr_cash_excluding_bank_transactions_2.outcome: Only relevant bank activity remains for matching.
scr_cash_excluding_bank_transactions_2.rootCause: Bank feeds sometimes include duplicates or memo lines; excluding them prevents false exceptions. Excluding real transactions, however, hides activity, so it requires justification.
scr_cash_excluding_bank_transactions_2.ifSkipped: False exceptions clutter the rec; misuse hides real bank debits.
redFlags: Excluded items that appear on the bank statement with real amounts

scr_cash_marking_bank_transactions_as_re.purpose: In the new tool, marks an unresolved bank transaction as a reconciling item so the rec can be finalized with the item tracked for follow-up.
scr_cash_marking_bank_transactions_as_re.outcome: Unresolved items are listed and aged rather than forced.
scr_cash_marking_bank_transactions_as_re.rootCause: Some items (unidentified deposits, bank errors pending correction) cannot be resolved by the deadline; tracking them keeps the rec honest and forces follow-up.
scr_cash_marking_bank_transactions_as_re.ifSkipped: Unresolved items are plugged or forgotten, and errors or fraud stay hidden in the difference.
redFlags: Reconciling items carried more than 60 days

scr_cash_creating_transactions_or_journa.purpose: From the Find Match page, creates the G/L transaction or journal entry for a bank-only item — bank fee, interest, NSF return, lender auto-debit — so it can be matched immediately.
scr_cash_creating_transactions_or_journa.outcome: Bank-originated items are recorded in the right accounts and cleared in the same reconciliation.
scr_cash_creating_transactions_or_journa.rootCause: Bank-only items only become known at reconciliation; creating the entry from within the match page records and clears them in one step.
scr_cash_creating_transactions_or_journa.ifSkipped: Bank-only items remain unrecorded and the rec does not balance.
redFlags: NSF returns booked to bank charges

scr_cash_adding_a_bank_transaction_to_in.purpose: Manually adds a bank transaction to the reconciliation when it is missing from the imported bank file — for example a late-posting item visible only on the PDF statement.
scr_cash_adding_a_bank_transaction_to_in.outcome: The bank side of the rec is complete even when the file was incomplete.
scr_cash_adding_a_bank_transaction_to_in.rootCause: Bank files occasionally omit transactions (late adjustments, cut-off timing). Adding them from the statement completes the bank side.
scr_cash_adding_a_bank_transaction_to_in.ifSkipped: The bank side is incomplete and the rec cannot balance.
redFlags: Manually added bank transactions not on the statement

scr_cash_viewing_alternate_bank_accounts.purpose: In the new tool, views balances and activity of alternate bank accounts to find items posted to the wrong account.
scr_cash_viewing_alternate_bank_accounts.outcome: Cross-account mis-postings are found and corrected.
scr_cash_viewing_alternate_bank_accounts.rootCause: Deposits recorded to operating instead of the trust account (or vice versa) create offsetting exceptions in two recs; viewing the other account shows the pair.
scr_cash_viewing_alternate_bank_accounts.ifSkipped: Two recs carry offsetting items and the trust account appears underfunded.
redFlags: Security deposits recorded in operating cash

scr_cash_finalizing_the_reconciliation_2.purpose: Finalizes a reconciliation in the new tool once all appropriate transactions are matched and the difference is zero.
scr_cash_finalizing_the_reconciliation_2.outcome: A locked reconciliation ready for submission and approval.
scr_cash_finalizing_the_reconciliation_2.rootCause: Finalizing freezes the result so later edits cannot silently alter it, and marks the point at which the preparer asserts the account is reconciled for the period.
scr_cash_finalizing_the_reconciliation_2.ifSkipped: Recs stay open and can change after review.
redFlags: Finalized with open exceptions not marked as reconciling items

scr_cash_troubleshooting_reconciliations.purpose: Troubleshooting guidance for differences in the new tool — wrong statement balance, prior-period changes, duplicate imports, missing bank lines.
scr_cash_troubleshooting_reconciliations.outcome: Preparers find root causes rather than plugging differences.
scr_cash_troubleshooting_reconciliations.rootCause: The new tool introduces its own failure modes (duplicate imports, rule mis-matches) in addition to classic ones; a checklist speeds diagnosis.
scr_cash_troubleshooting_reconciliations.ifSkipped: Differences are plugged and real errors remain.
redFlags: Duplicate bank file imports

scr_cash_print_payment_copies_page.purpose: Page for printing or emailing copies of vendor payments (checks and electronic payments) for a chosen period and range.
scr_cash_print_payment_copies_page.outcome: Payment copies for vendors, files or audit samples.
scr_cash_print_payment_copies_page.rootCause: Proof-of-payment requests from vendors and auditors are routine; a dedicated page answers them from system records.
scr_cash_print_payment_copies_page.ifSkipped: Proof-of-payment requests are slow and vendors may resubmit invoices.
redFlags: Copies produced for voided payments without noting void status

scr_cash_viewing_the_print_payment_copie.purpose: Views the payment copies selected before printing or emailing to confirm the correct payments are included.
scr_cash_viewing_the_print_payment_copie.rootCause: Sending the wrong payment copy to a vendor exposes other vendors' payment and bank information.
scr_cash_viewing_the_print_payment_copie.ifSkipped: Wrong payment copies reach vendors, disclosing other vendors' payment details.
redFlags: Copies including other vendors' payments

scr_cash_setting_up_the_search_parameter.purpose: Selects the period and range of payments (check numbers, vendors, bank accounts) to find payment copies.
scr_cash_setting_up_the_search_parameter.outcome: A targeted search returning exactly the requested payments.
scr_cash_setting_up_the_search_parameter.rootCause: Precise search parameters produce exactly the payments requested, avoiding over-disclosure.
scr_cash_setting_up_the_search_parameter.ifSkipped: Searches return too many or the wrong payments.
redFlags: Broad searches emailed to a vendor

scr_cash_printing_payment_copies.purpose: Two-step process — search for payments, then print their copies — used to produce physical or PDF proof of vendor payments for files, vendors or auditors.
scr_cash_printing_payment_copies.outcome: Printed payment copies ready for the requester or the disbursement file.
scr_cash_printing_payment_copies.rootCause: Some vendors, auditors and owners still require printed or PDF payment copies for their records. Producing them from the system ensures they match what was actually paid.
scr_cash_printing_payment_copies.ifSkipped: File support for payments is incomplete and audit disbursement testing takes longer.
redFlags: Printed copies stored without access control

scr_cash_setting_the_time_period.purpose: Chooses a predefined (this month, last month) or custom date range for the payment copies search, matching the period a vendor or auditor asked about.
scr_cash_setting_the_time_period.outcome: Output limited to payments within the requested dates.
scr_cash_setting_the_time_period.rootCause: Vendor and audit requests are usually for specific months; limiting by period avoids irrelevant results.
scr_cash_setting_the_time_period.ifSkipped: Irrelevant payments are included in the output.
redFlags: Period not matching the request

scr_cash_setting_print_filters.purpose: Filters the payment copy search by vendor, bank account, property or payment type.
scr_cash_setting_print_filters.outcome: Output limited to the requested vendor or account.
scr_cash_setting_print_filters.rootCause: Filtering prevents disclosing one vendor's payments to another and keeps outputs focused.
scr_cash_setting_print_filters.ifSkipped: Output includes unrelated vendors' payments and may be sent to the wrong party.
redFlags: Missing vendor filter when responding to a vendor

scr_cash_sorting_payments.purpose: Controls the check number range and sort order (by check number, vendor or date) of the payment copies output, so reviewers and auditors can find specific payments quickly.
scr_cash_sorting_payments.outcome: Output ordered for easy review (by check number or vendor).
scr_cash_sorting_payments.rootCause: Auditors sample by check number; sorting by number makes it easy to locate samples.
scr_cash_sorting_payments.ifSkipped: Output is hard to navigate for sampling.
redFlags: Gaps in check number sequence in output

scr_cash_sending_payment_notification_em.purpose: Sends payment notification emails (remittance advice) to vendors with details of the invoices a payment covers.
scr_cash_sending_payment_notification_em.outcome: Vendors know which invoices were paid, reducing inquiries and misapplied payments on their side.
scr_cash_sending_payment_notification_em.rootCause: Electronic payments arrive without paper stubs; without remittance advice vendors cannot apply payments and keep calling or re-billing.
scr_cash_sending_payment_notification_em.ifSkipped: Vendor inquiries and duplicate invoices increase.
redFlags: Notifications sent to addresses not on the vendor record

scr_cash_applying_the_search_parameters.purpose: Runs the payment copies search with the chosen parameters and displays the results.
scr_cash_applying_the_search_parameters.outcome: The list of matching payments to print or email.
scr_cash_applying_the_search_parameters.rootCause: Reviewing results before output is the check that the parameters captured exactly the intended payments.
scr_cash_applying_the_search_parameters.ifSkipped: The wrong payments are printed or emailed without anyone checking the result set.
redFlags: Results not reviewed before emailing

scr_cash_reports.purpose: Reports section of Cash Management — available cash, cash balances, cash analysis, cash visibility, PC card reports, bank transaction summary and bank, check and deposit registers.
scr_cash_reports.outcome: Cash evidence for owner packages, treasury decisions and audit.
scr_cash_reports.rootCause: Owner packages need cash balances and reconciled registers; treasury needs available cash for distributions and funding.
scr_cash_reports.ifSkipped: Owner packages lack cash support and treasury decisions lack data.
redFlags: Cash reports run before recs are finalized

scr_cash_my_stored_reports_list.purpose: Lists cash reports the user has run and stored — bank registers, cash balances, available cash — with the date each was generated.
scr_cash_my_stored_reports_list.outcome: Point-in-time copies of cash reports available without rerunning.
scr_cash_my_stored_reports_list.rootCause: Cash balances change daily; a stored month-end cash balances or available cash report preserves exactly what supported the close or a distribution decision.
scr_cash_my_stored_reports_list.ifSkipped: The evidence behind a distribution decision cannot be reproduced once later transactions post.
redFlags: Stored reports without period in the name

scr_cash_storing_standard_reports_and_ch.purpose: Explains storing cash reports and charts — generated in the background and saved — rather than viewing them live.
scr_cash_storing_standard_reports_and_ch.outcome: Large cash registers run without timing out and are kept for reference.
scr_cash_storing_standard_reports_and_ch.rootCause: Portfolio-wide bank registers are large and time out when viewed live; storing them also freezes month-end evidence.
scr_cash_storing_standard_reports_and_ch.ifSkipped: Large reports fail and month-end evidence is not retained.
redFlags: Month-end cash reports not stored

scr_cash_viewing_a_stored_report.purpose: Opens a stored cash report — for example the month-end Cash Balances or Available Cash report — once the system has finished generating it in the background.
scr_cash_viewing_a_stored_report.outcome: Access to the saved output for review or distribution.
scr_cash_viewing_a_stored_report.rootCause: Stored reports are the frozen version used as evidence; viewing them rather than rerunning ensures consistency with what was reported.
scr_cash_viewing_a_stored_report.ifSkipped: Reports are rerun and differ from what was used at close.
redFlags: Reviewers using rerun reports instead of stored month-end versions

scr_cash_choosing_file_types_to_store_re.purpose: Chooses the file format (PDF, Excel, CSV) in which a cash report or chart is stored — PDF for owner-facing packages, Excel or CSV for analysis and reconciliation work.
scr_cash_choosing_file_types_to_store_re.outcome: Reports stored in the format their audience needs — PDF for owner packages, Excel for analysis.
scr_cash_choosing_file_types_to_store_re.rootCause: Owners want tamper-evident PDFs while accountants need Excel to analyze; picking the right format avoids rework.
scr_cash_choosing_file_types_to_store_re.ifSkipped: Reports must be rerun in another format.
redFlags: Editable formats sent as final owner deliverables

scr_cash_deleting_a_stored_report.purpose: Deletes a stored cash report that is no longer needed (reports are kept until deleted).
scr_cash_deleting_a_stored_report.rootCause: Unmanaged stored reports accumulate, making the right month-end version hard to find; but deleting close evidence breaks retention.
scr_cash_deleting_a_stored_report.ifSkipped: Clutter; if misused, loss of retained evidence.
redFlags: Deleting month-end cash reports within the retention period

scr_cash_storage_options_page.purpose: Chooses where a cash report is stored when processed — My Stored Reports, a cloud storage target or the Reporting Portal.
scr_cash_storage_options_page.outcome: Reports land where their audience can access them (e.g., the owner's portal).
scr_cash_storage_options_page.rootCause: Owner packages increasingly go to portals or shared cloud storage; storing directly avoids manual uploads and version confusion.
scr_cash_storage_options_page.ifSkipped: Reports are downloaded and uploaded manually, risking wrong versions.
redFlags: Reports stored to shared locations without access restrictions

scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_my_stored_r.purpose: Stores a processed cash report — bank register, cash balances, available cash — in the user's My Stored Reports so the exact month-end output can be reopened later.
scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_my_stored_r.outcome: A personal, retained copy of the cash report.
scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_my_stored_r.rootCause: Preparers need a retained copy of the exact cash report they used for reconciliation or distribution support.
scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_my_stored_r.ifSkipped: The preparer cannot reproduce the report used.
redFlags: Only personal copies kept, not shared close evidence

scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_a_cloud_sto.purpose: Stores a processed cash report in a configured cloud storage location (e.g., SharePoint or other cloud targets).
scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_a_cloud_sto.outcome: Cash reports saved automatically to the team's or owner's document repository.
scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_a_cloud_sto.rootCause: Many offshore teams deliver month-end packages via SharePoint; direct storage removes the manual upload step that often gets missed.
scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_a_cloud_sto.ifSkipped: Owner folders miss cash reports or contain outdated ones.
redFlags: Cloud targets with broad access

scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_reporting_p.purpose: Stores a processed cash report in the RealPage Reporting Portal for distribution to owners and investors.
scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_reporting_p.outcome: Owners access cash reports through the portal.
scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_reporting_p.rootCause: The Reporting Portal is the owner-facing distribution channel; storing there publishes the report to the right audience.
scr_cash_storing_a_report_in_reporting_p.ifSkipped: Owners do not receive cash reports through their expected channel.
redFlags: Draft reports published to the portal

scr_cash_memorized_reports.purpose: Explains memorized cash reports — saved report settings (accounts, filters, columns) that can be rerun or scheduled.
scr_cash_memorized_reports.outcome: Standard cash reports can be regenerated identically each month.
scr_cash_memorized_reports.rootCause: Consistency month to month matters for owner packages; memorized settings prevent parameter drift.
scr_cash_memorized_reports.ifSkipped: Cash reports vary by preparer and month, and owners see inconsistent packages.
redFlags: Owner package reports run with ad hoc settings

scr_cash_memorizing_a_report_or_chart.purpose: Saves the current settings of a cash report or chart — bank accounts, date basis, columns, grouping — as a memorized report for reuse.
scr_cash_memorizing_a_report_or_chart.outcome: A reusable, consistent definition of a standard cash report.
scr_cash_memorizing_a_report_or_chart.rootCause: Rebuilding complex cash report settings every month wastes time and invites mistakes such as leaving out the trust account or using the wrong date basis.
scr_cash_memorizing_a_report_or_chart.ifSkipped: Parameters are rebuilt monthly and errors slip into owner packages.
redFlags: Memorized reports with hard-coded prior periods

scr_cash_memorized_reports_list.purpose: Lists memorized cash reports with actions to run, edit, schedule or delete, forming the team's library of standard cash reports for the close.
scr_cash_memorized_reports_list.outcome: A library of standard cash reports for the team.
scr_cash_memorized_reports_list.rootCause: Shared libraries ensure every preparer uses the same report definitions for the close.
scr_cash_memorized_reports_list.ifSkipped: Preparers use different definitions and owner packages differ between properties.
redFlags: Duplicate memorized reports with different settings
